title: Footage from earlier uncrewed lunar mission misrepresented as Artemis II’s return
desc: Four NASA astronauts safely returned to Earth on April 10, 2026 following the first lunar flyby in more than 50 years, but footage shared on Chinese social media posts does not show the Artemis II crew splashing down in the Pacific. The clip is an edited version of archival footage by the US space agency and was taken during a previous uncrewed test flight in November 2022.
